title: Evidence, findings, uncertainty and action scope remain distinct
summary: Observations are retained as evidence; findings are interpretations; counterevidence and unknowns remain explicit; the operative assessment is made for an exact action surface. A third-party allegation is not silently promoted to truth.
invariants: Counterevidence and unknowns travel with the concern.
No generic hasFlag() or riskScore(customer) authority should replace action-scoped assessment.
Evidence freshness and temporal validity are explicit.

provenance.claim: README documents evidence uncertainty, action scoping, and cross-domain mapping discipline.
